visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in an indoor playroom with light-colored wooden walls and a patterned yellow carpet. A young girl with pigtails and white bows, wearing a pink tank top and denim shorts, stands holding the hand of a man in a white t-shirt and a black baseball cap. The man looks down at her and smiles while she focuses on a wooden train set on the floor. (2) The camera shifts to show another man in a pink t-shirt and glasses standing next to a woman in a black and white striped top. They are watching the girl and laughing. In the background, a small child plays with a wooden train track laid out on the carpet near a large cardboard box. (3) The girl continues to hold the hand of the man in the white shirt, looking down at the toys. The man in the pink shirt approaches her. The camera moves to a closer shot of the girl's face as she looks up at the man she is holding hands with, her expression transitioning from neutral to confused. (4) Upon realizing she is holding a stranger's hand, the girl looks toward the man in the pink shirt. He laughs and crouches down to reach for her. The man in the white shirt also laughs, pointing toward her. The girl walks toward the man in pink, who picks her up and lifts her into the air while other people in the background watch and smile.
